messages:
Elena Morales: Quick sync — we need final landing copy for Hosted / Dedicated / Private. Goal: 3 hero variants, a short benchmark blurb, webinar CTA, and inbound routing notes. Drop microcopy + routing by EOD? @Raf @Tess
Raf Chen: On my radar. Draft hero options: "Production-grade inference, without the ops"; "Ship LLM features with predictable latency and cost"; "One API. Any deployment."
Tess King: I prefer the 2nd. For Dedicated hero: "Reserved GPU pools for predictable throughput and SLAs." Follow with 3 bullets: autoscale policies, burst capacity, data isolation.
Ben Ortiz: Private page microcopy: "Run Redwood in your VPC or on-prem — full network control, KMS/HSM-ready, enterprise audit logs." Keep it confidence-forward, not too technical.
Elena Morales: @Raf please add a 1-line benchmark blurb for the Hosted hero (placeholders ok): p95 latency + rough cost per 1k tokens. Don9t promise without infra sign-off.
Raf Chen: Placeholder: "Typical chat: p95 < 120ms; optimized flows cost ~ $0.02 / 1k tokens." Will flag as provisional.
Tess King: CTA matrix to A/B test: Primary CTAs = "Start free trial" (Hosted), "Request Dedicated pricing" (Dedicated), "Contact sales for Private" (Private). Secondary CTA: "See benchmarks".
growth-bot: :gear: Experiment created: /experiments/landing-copy-2026. Variants A=product-first, B=benchmark-led, C=security-first. Tracking utm=tri-mode-copy.
Ben Ortiz: Inbound routing plan: Hosted -> self-serve trial signup; Dedicated -> sales form (SFDC lead type: Dedicated); Private -> enterprise contact -> solutions-eng ticket. I'll wire webhooks and SFDC mapping.
Elena Morales: Also planning a short webinar: "Serving at scale: latency & cost playbook". Add registration CTA and downloadable 1-page benchmark PDF on landing. Target date ~3 weeks.
Raf Chen: Proposed tri-mode hero: "One API, three deployment modes — hosted for speed, dedicated for predictability, private for control." Subhead: "Same SDKs and routes, different guarantees. Ship faster, scale cheaper."
Tess King: Social microcopy: "New landing: one API, three deployment choices. Webinar + benchmarks live. Pick the deployment that fits your latency and compliance needs."
Ben Ortiz: Example webhook payload for Dedicated form -> /webhooks/sales (implementation note):
```
{
  "lead_type": "dedicated",
  "utm_source": "website",
  "plan_interest": "dedicated",
  "email": "..."
}
```
Map to SFDC queue: sales-dedicated-queue.
Elena Morales: @Tess add A/B test params + analytics events. I want funnel mapping by CTA.
Tess King: Done in doc: utm params and events: `landing.cta.click`, `landing.benchmark.view`, `landing.webinar.register`. Will wire to GA4 + Segment props.
Raf Chen: I left copy comments and a short benchmark appendix in the doc. Will replace placeholder metrics after infra validation.
Ben Ortiz: Routing doc WIP: https://confluence.redwood/inbound-routing. Will update endpoints + SFDC mapping by EOD. JIRA tasks created: INF-9123 (hosted), INF-9124 (dedicated), INF-9125 (private).
Elena Morales: Final note: Private page should lead with control & compliance, then optional managed services. Avoid deep infra promises. Thanks everyone — final review tomorrow AM. :rocket:
